# Combine all GSEA results files into one merged table

#===================================================================
# SCOPE: connects two separate projects (GSEA_cleaned and
# publication_cleaned), which run in different R environments. This
# script does ONE simple thing: reads every GSEA results CSV in
# GSEA_SOURCE_DIR (one per collection -- GO_BP, KEGG, etc., each a
# flat table with one row per pathway) and concatenates them into one
# merged CSV, tagged with which file each pathway came from.
#
# No filtering, no category assignment happens here -- selecting
# specific pathways of interest (by ID) and assigning them to curated
# categories happens directly in
# 07_gene_expression_heatmap_figure2_cleaned.Rmd, which reads this
# merged file and looks up genes for whichever IDs you list there.
#===================================================================

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(tools)

# ---- 0. Paths -----------------------------------------------------------
# External, separate-project path (GSEA_cleaned) -- see header note.
GSEA_SOURCE_DIR <- "/media/Aleksandra/Computational/R programming/paper_projects/GSEA_cleaned/processed/Figure2_GSEA/GSEA"

OUTPUT_DIR <- "/media/Aleksandra/Computational/R programming/paper_projects/GSEA_cleaned/output/Figure2_GSEA/tables/"
OUTPUT_CSV <- file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "combined_gsea_results.csv")

stopifnot(dir.exists(GSEA_SOURCE_DIR))
```

```{r}
# ---- 1. Read and merge every GSEA results CSV in the folder ---------------
result_files <- list.files(GSEA_SOURCE_DIR, pattern = "\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE, ignore.case = TRUE)
cat("Found", length(result_files), "result files:\n")
print(basename(result_files))

read_one_results_file <- function(path) {
  df <- read.csv(path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  required <- c("ID", "Description", "core_enrichment")
  missing <- setdiff(required, colnames(df))
  if (length(missing) > 0) {
    warning(basename(path), " is missing expected columns: ", paste(missing, collapse = ", "),
            " -- skipping this file.")
    return(NULL)
  }
  df$source_file <- file_path_sans_ext(basename(path))
  df[, c("ID", "Description", "NES", "pvalue", "p.adjust", "core_enrichment", "source_file")]
}

combined_gsea_results <- map(result_files, read_one_results_file) %>% compact() %>% bind_rows()

cat("\nTotal pathways merged:", nrow(combined_gsea_results), "\n")
cat("Pathways per source file:\n")
print(table(combined_gsea_results$source_file))
```

```{r}
# ---- 2. Save the merged CSV ------------------------------------------------
write.csv(combined_gsea_results, OUTPUT_CSV, row.names = FALSE)
cat("\nSaved:", OUTPUT_CSV, "\n")
cat("07_gene_expression_heatmap_figure2_cleaned.Rmd reads this file directly --\n")
cat("select specific pathways of interest (by ID) there.\n")
```
